case.note: The cutaneous branches are accounted for (m1.3) and the release extent is stated (m2.3), but the ulnar nerve itself is never identified or protected: crit1 is not performed before the proximal fascia is divided at t=1140s. The runner's misidentification resolution passes the division through the unvisualised nerve - the operation's catastrophic injury. Exemplary management follows (recognition, senior help, immediate microscope repair) and scores 5/5; it does not rescue the verdict, exactly as at Milestones 17, 28 and 42.

trace.name: Ulnar nerve decompression: division before identification - ulnar nerve injury
